CI has no sibling checkout, so `GalleryTabEndToEndTests.testOpeningARecordedSessionShowsItsTranscript` fails with "The start of the Gallery failed" (CI run 38248679318, rerun). +- [ ] The connection uses the in-process transport, the same as `InProcessAgent` / `makeInProcess`. Remove the code that starts the sibling program for the Gallery, and any launch option, environment or doc that only that path used (check `DemoLaunchOptions` and the README). Do not leave a second way.
+- [ ] If the ACP tab or other code also starts the sibling `acp-agent` program, record it; do not change it on this card unless it is the same code.
+- [ ] Tests: the package test that opens the recorded sessions runs the in-process agent (no sibling binary). The Gallery UI test must pass on CI. Do not run UI tests on this machine.
+- [ ] Update the README and `RecordedSessions/README.md`.
